description: Built-in starting list of well-known Open Badges issuing platforms, by domain. A badge whose issuer id (OB 2.0 issuer profile URL, OB 3.0 did:web host or https issuer) is on one of these domains or a subdomain of it counts as a trusted issuer without further checks. Being on this list means the platform hosts and signs the badge for an issuing organisation it has onboarded; it does not vouch for the issuing organisation's name, which staff still see in the evidence. This is a starting list, not a registry: extend it deliberately (with a source) and prefer the per-organisation list (Admin > Verification > Trusted badge issuers) for local issuers.
